description: Message that gets sent out when the source state changes

flow_id.description: ID of the flow carrying the message

source_id.description: ID of the source that holds the state that has changed

message_type.description: A fixed string showing this is a state message

action_timestamp.description: String formatted TAI timestamp (<seconds>:<nanoseconds>) indicating when the state change described in the event took or will take place

creation_timestamp.description: String formatted TAI timestamp (<seconds>:<nanoseconds>) indicating when the message was created

origin_timestamp.description: String formatted TAI timestamp (<seconds>:<nanoseconds>) indicating when the message that triggered this message (if any) was created

title: State change event
